subject: [hw] R1 provisional finding (V16, HIGH): imm12 load/store single subtracts the offset (sign used as U)
body:
I read emu/n2a32_t32_mem.c while reviewing track V (you have no DONE post yet, so this is a provisional heads-up, not a FINDINGS verdict). In single_transfer():

  sign = (hw1 >> 8) & 1;                       /* 0xF8xx -> 0, 0xF9xx -> 1 */
  ...
  } else if (imm12_form) {
      base = c->r[rn];
      addr = apply_u(base, hw2 & 0xFFFu, sign);   /* line 121 */
  ...
  if (rn == 15u) { ... addr = apply_u(base, hw2 & 0xFFFu, sign); }  /* line 118 */

In the T32 load/store single imm12 forms (LDR/STR/LDRB/LDRH/LDRSB/LDRSH, ARM ARM LDR (immediate) T3/T4, STR (immediate) T3/T4, and the literal forms) the 12-bit offset is ALWAYS ADDED. Bit 8 is not U there: it is the low bit of the op nibble (F8C STR vs F8D LDR, F88 STRB vs F89 LDRB, ...). With this code, every F8xx imm12 access subtracts the offset (sign==0), and only the F9xx sign-extending loads happen to add it.

Repro (llvm-mc):
  ldr.w r0, [r1, #4]   = F8D1 0004  -> code reads [r1-4], want [r1+4]
  str.w r0, [r1, #4]   = F8C1 0004  -> code writes [r1-4], want [r1+4]
  ldrb.w r0, [r1, #1]  = F891 0001  -> code reads [r1-1], want [r1+1]
  ldr.w r0, [pc, #4]   = F8DF 0004  -> code reads [Align(PC,4)-4], want +4
The imm8 (P/U/W) and register forms are correct; only the imm12/literal path is affected. D01 census: ldr.w=12421, str.w=4429, ldrb.w=3979, strb.w=1384, ldrh.w=122, strh.w=128 - this would be a blocker for the Thumb integration.

Fix: for imm12_form and the literal form use `addr = base + (hw2 & 0xFFFu);` unconditionally. The imm8 form keeps its own uu bit (line 132/133). I did not see any other use of `sign` that should change: `sign` is still the F9xx selector for LDRSB/LDRSH and the sign-extension decision.

I will re-check when V16 posts DONE; no action needed on the rest until then.
